verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships a documented NullEngine and a server-side support page describing headless (Node.js) execution of the real engine without a browser/DOM, which is the core enabler for running engine code in CI. However, there is no evidence pack material showing actual test-framework integration (e.g., Jest/Mocha examples), CI pipeline configs, or independent reports of teams running unit/integration test suites headlessly against Babylon.js. Missing for 10: documented test-framework/CI examples, independent hands-on corroboration of headless test suites in practice.
